errors.text: The fracture morphology is reversed: the target reports distributed/isolated microcracks after HPHT and elongated catastrophic cracks in the baseline, whereas the generated hypothesis assigns elongated cracks to the treated sample and isolated microcracks to the baseline.
The predicted outcome omits the central quantitative result of approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% tensile elongation, both nearly doubled relative to baseline.
The cited evidence is generic and does not directly establish the claimed HPHT-induced topology change in Al0.7CoCrFeNi under 6 GPa, 1473 K, and 2 hours.
